standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherence of the pullback of a quasi-coherent module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that the pullback of a quasi-coherent module along an etale morphism of algebraic spaces is quasi-coherent

core_obligations: (1) implies (2) (proof lines 5626-5628): the identity morphism of X is etale and surjective on points, so condition (2) holds trivially.

(2) implies (3) (proof lines 5628-5635): composing the etale surjection f with a surjective etale morphism from a scheme onto Y gives a surjective etale morphism from a scheme onto X, and the pullback of the module to that scheme is quasi-coherent by the pullback lemma.

(3) implies (1) (proof lines 5637-5651): assuming the pullback to a scheme U is quasi-coherent, choose an etale covering of U on which that pullback admits a global presentation; for an object V of the etale site of X the fibre products of the covering members with V form an etale covering of V, and restricting the global presentations along these maps produces global presentations of the pullback of the module to V, which is exactly the site-local condition for quasi-coherence.

(3) and (4) are equivalent (proof lines 5651-5653): any scheme admits an affine open covering, so the existence of one surjective etale chart with quasi-coherent pullback is equivalent to the same property for every affine etale chart.
proof_roadmap: Dispose of the trivial implication using the identity morphism.
Compose an etale surjection onto the intermediate space with a chart to descend the hypothesis to a scheme chart.
Use local presentations of the quasi-coherent pullback to produce presentations on every object of the site, and reduce the last condition to affine charts.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of four conditions characterizing quasi-coherence of a module on an algebraic space: quasi-coherence itself, quasi-coherence after pullback along a surjective-on-points etale morphism, after pullback along a surjective etale chart by a scheme, and after pullback along every affine etale chart (statement lines 5608-5624). The proof (proof lines 5626-5655) chains the implications, using local presentations of the pullback to obtain presentations on every object of the etale site, and reduces the last condition to affine charts. H2: a cycle of implications with two inputs, written out in full.
